questions.question: In your role at Construction Management Enterprises, you handled accounts payable/receivable, expense tracking, bank reconciliations, and deposits. Walk me through your month-end process and the controls you used to ensure transactions were complete and accurate.
Describe a time you analyzed financial records to identify an error, inconsistency, or potential fraud. What was your methodology, what evidence did you review, and what was the outcome?

At Postlethwaite & Netterville, you reviewed financial documents and developed monetary values for business-interruption claims. How did you validate source data and maintain quality control when working through a high volume of claims?

This role requires analysis of ledger accounts against budget, prior month results, and annual trends. Please describe a financial analysis you performed, the key variances you identified, and how you communicated your findings.
Tell me about your experience paying subcontractors and accounting for third-party partnership expenses. How did you verify approvals, coding, supporting documentation, and payment accuracy?
What types of Excel analyses, models, or reports have you built for accounting, financial analysis, forensic work, or operational reporting? Which functions or tools did you use most frequently?

Describe a situation in which you managed several competing projects or deadlines at once. How did you establish priorities, track progress, and ensure important accounting or operational tasks were completed on time?
The position will support a global consolidated audit. What has been your experience preparing financial documentation for review by accountants, attorneys, auditors, or other external stakeholders?

You have developed operating guidelines, training materials, and process documentation. Can you give an example of a workflow or process you documented or improved, including how you identified the issue and measured success?

This role involves becoming a resource on U.S. expense policies across multiple offices. How have you explained policies or financial requirements to non-finance colleagues and handled situations where submitted expenses or documentation did not meet requirements?
